title: I Can't: Strategies To Overcoming Your Limiting Beliefs
author: Anthony Brown Sr.
description:
Almost everything Anthony Brown Sr. is doing today, he once believed he could not do. He grew up one of six, moving from hotel to hotel, with stretches of no address at all. I Can't is the book he needed back then.

This is not motivation for the moment. It is a clear path for finding the beliefs quietly running your decisions, understanding why your brain holds on to them, and replacing them with ones that move you forward. Ten chapters, an exercise at the end of each one, and the lessons that took him from no address to building a life on purpose.

If you are successful on paper but still hear the voice that says you are not ready, this is for you.
